name: linear_regression_cv
desc: Evaluates a federated linear regression model using K-fold cross-validation. Each fold trains a global model and reports metrics over the held-out data.
label: Linear Regression (K-Fold CV)

x.label: Independent Variables
x.desc: One or more predictors (numerical or nominal). Nominal variables are one-hot encoded with a global schema across workers.

n_splits.label: Number of Folds
n_splits.desc: Number of folds for K-fold cross-validation.
